claim: With the Detective integrations with GuardDuty and Security Hub CSPM, you can pivot from a GuardDuty finding in those services directly into the Detective console; the Security Hub CSPM integration with Detective does not require any additional configuration in Security Hub CSPM or Detective.

qualifiers.condition: the no-configuration statement is made for the Security Hub CSPM integration with Detective

evidence.quote: Using the Detective integrations with GuardDuty and AWS Security Hub CSPM, you can pivot from a GuardDuty finding in these services directly into the Detective console.

The Security Hub CSPM integration with Detective allows you to pivot from Amazon GuardDuty findings in Security Hub CSPM into Detective. You can then use the Detective tools and visualizations to investigate them. The integration does not require any additional configuration in Security Hub CSPM or Detective.
